name: security
description: Wick-style server protection: anti-nuke detection with automatic quarantine.

configFields.label: Anti-Nuke
configFields.description: Watch the audit log for mass destructive actions.

configFields.label: Detection Window
configFields.description: Sliding window in seconds for counting actions.

configFields.label: Max Bans
configFields.description: Bans allowed per executor within the window.

configFields.label: Max Kicks
configFields.description: Kicks allowed per executor within the window.

configFields.label: Max Channel Deletes
configFields.description: Channel deletions allowed per executor within the window.

configFields.label: Max Role Deletes
configFields.description: Role deletions allowed per executor within the window.

configFields.label: Max Webhook Creates
configFields.description: Webhook creations allowed per executor within the window.

configFields.label: Response
configFields.description: What to do when an executor trips a threshold.

configFields.label: Trusted Roles
configFields.description: Comma-separated role IDs exempt from anti-nuke.

configFields.label: Security Log Channel
configFields.description: Channel for anti-nuke alerts (falls back to mod log).
